CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION eflow_publication.subtask_staffing_locked(p_root uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select exists(select 1 from public.tasks t join public.projects p on p.id=t.linked_project_id
  where t.id=p_root and p.status='active' and p.project_lead_id=auth.uid());
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION eflow_r7.head(p_root uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select eflow_r3.eligible(auth.uid()) and case when r->>'kind'='office' then eflow_phase6.head((r->>'project')::uuid,(r->>'office')::uuid,auth.uid()) else (r->>'owner')::uuid=auth.uid() end from (select eflow_r7.root(p_root) r) x
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION eflow_publication.planning_lead(p_project uuid, p_office uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select exists(select 1 from public.projects p join public.profiles u on u.id=auth.uid()
  where p.id=p_project and p.org_id=p_office and p.source_collaboration_draft_id is null
  and p.status in ('planning','active','on_hold') and p.project_lead_id=u.id
  and u.org_id=p.org_id and u.is_active and u.role not in ('admin','super_admin','viewer'));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION eflow_publication.manage_plan(p_root uuid, p_node uuid, p_replace_lead boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select coalesce(eflow_r7.manage(p_root,p_node,p_replace_lead),false) or (
  coalesce(eflow_r7.read_root(p_root),false) and exists (
   select 1 from (select eflow_r7.root(p_root) r) x where r->>'kind'='office'
    and coalesce((r->>'open')::boolean,false)
    and eflow_publication.planning_lead((r->>'project')::uuid,(r->>'office')::uuid)
  ));
$function$
